---
title: AI Query
---

Send text queries or multimodal image inputs to Gemini and display the responses inside a spatial `UICard`.

> [!NOTE]
> For local prototyping, the pre-launch dialog accepts a Gemini API key stored locally in your browser. Production applications must proxy AI requests through a secure server.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Ask Gemini:** Left-click **Ask about WebXR** or **Describe sample** to submit prompts.
- **Move / Resize Card:** Left-click and drag the card border to reposition, or scroll with the mouse wheel to scale.
- **Rotate:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.

### XR Controls

- **Ask Gemini:** Ray-pinch or tap the prompt buttons on the card.
- **Reposition Card:** Pinch the card border and drag to place it in your space.
